brief:
Israeli occupation forces installed metal gates at entrances to several villages, towns and intersections in Jenin governorate on Monday, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources told the Wafa news agency that the barriers were placed at access points including al-Jalmeh and other locations across the northern West Bank district.

The installation appears part of ongoing Israeli military operations restricting movement in Palestinian areas. Details of the full scope and stated purpose of the gate placements were not immediately available.

title: Israeli forces install metal gates at entrances to Jenin villages
